english.note: Use this when emphasizing the debate or exchange of opposing arguments rather than the controversial issue itself.
Use this when the disagreement is a debate or an exchange of opposing arguments rather than a quarrel.
Use this when the debate emphasizes people arguing over opposing views, even if they remain civil.
Use this when the dispute is a verbal debate or controversy about an issue.

examples.english: They are still debating whether prices should be raised, keeping the controversy alive.
examples.traditional: 佢哋仲喺度爭論緊應唔應該加價。
